messages:
priya_pm: Heads-up — noticing multiple support tickets and AE asks that map to 'per-tenant usage by model' (visibility/export). Looks like duplicates across accounts. Thinking we should cluster into one canonical backlog item and reply with a consolidated status. Thoughts?

mike_support: Agree. I pulled ~7 support threads last week. Samples: INC-3421, INC-3499, INC-3572. Some are usage questions, some are feature asks. We should separate docs/playbook vs product work.

lisa_sales: From AE side — 3 prospects asked for export of usage by model per-tenant. High revenue sensitivity for at least two. @priya_pm can we evaluate for Q2?

derek_engineer: We have a past spike note (internal) about billing telemetry. Technically doable by aggregating the billing stream. Suggest tags: request:usage-visibility + investigate:api. Low-risk spike, could prototype.

priya_pm: Proposal: create one canonical ticket 'usage-by-model-per-tenant' in roadmap backlog, attach support examples & AE notes, priority=P2. Assign a feasibility spike to @derek_engineer. Who will notify requesters? @mike_support / @lisa_sales?

mike_support: I'll send a consolidated customer note this afternoon. Plan: TL;DR we're tracking this as one request, will update with status, and share a workaround if available. Template ready.

lisa_sales: :thumbsup: I'll cc the AEs on the outbound so prospects feel seen.

triage-bot: Automated: created backlog item PROD-1187 'usage-by-model-per-tenant' with tags [investigate, revenue-impact, customer-request].

priya_pm: Great. Two asks: (1) @derek_engineer post a 1-line feasibility summary in PROD-1187 by EOD Fri; (2) @mike_support paste the list of duplicate support IDs into the canonical ticket.

derek_engineer: Will do. Quick note: viable approach = reusing billing aggregation + add endpoint that respects tenant ACLs. Rough estimate: 3-4 dev days for MVP + 1 day tests + infra tweak for auth.

mike_support: Pasted ticket list into PROD-1187 and linked the threads. Sent consolidation note to 5 customers, copied AEs. Message I sent:

"Hi — we're consolidating similar requests under PROD-1187. We're tracking priority based on customer impact and revenue. We'll post updates here; if you need a workaround in the meantime DM me. — Mike"

priya_pm: Perfect. I'll flag PROD-1187 as 'candidate for Q2 review' and add to the planning board. Leaving this thread open for updates and closing once we have feasibility + rough ETA.

mike_support: Noted. Will update here once we get any replies from customers. :white_check_mark:
